summary.intent: Configure GSD workflow settings, generate a developer behavioral profile from session analysis, then clean up stale `.claude/claude.md` by merging it with the newly generated root `CLAUDE.md`, fix a dead path reference in sync.md, and push everything to a chore branch PR.
summary.outcome: All three goals completed: GSD config updated (adaptive model, TDD on, deep code review, intel/graphify/auto-advance enabled), a full 8-dimension developer profile written to USER-PROFILE.md with artifacts, `.claude/claude.md` merged into root `CLAUDE.md` with verified/corrected content and old file deleted, sync.md path fixed, and changes pushed to a `chore/` branch with a PR.

repo: Playwright MCP is NOT configured for this project; only Puppeteer MCP is active (defined in `~/.claude.json`). Any docs referencing `mcp__playwright__*` tool names were wrong.
Pencil MCP is not configured anywhere in the project; designs live in `designs/cipher-box-design.pen` and `designs/DESIGN.md`.

Release Please now uses independent per-package versions (root 0.38.5, web 0.41.0, fuse 0.5.3…), not a single unified version; `include-component-in-tag` is set and only `apps/desktop` propagates to `tauri.conf.json`/`Cargo.toml` via extra-files.
Staging tags are `staging-YYYYMMDD-release-N` (created by `tag-staging.yml` manual dispatch behind `staging-approval` environment), NOT `staging-v*-rc-N`. Deploy triggers on `staging-*` prefix.

Sharing, file versioning, and client-side search are fully implemented v1.0 features (`apps/api/src/shares/`, `file-metadata.service.ts`, `search-index.service.ts`). Remaining out-of-scope items are billing, mobile, collab editing, and team accounts (Milestone 4/v2.0).
Desktop uses FUSE on macOS/Linux but WinFsp on Windows; TEE is Phala in production but a local Docker simulator in staging (introduced in commit f270d843a).
The `.husky/commit-msg` hook was clobbered by an Entire CLI wrapper in commit 0d37d710b and no longer runs commitlint locally. Only the PR-title CI check enforces conventional commit format.
The UI-keyword heuristic for design/sync now exists only in `.claude/commands/design/sync.md`; the three files it previously cross-referenced no longer exist.

code.finding: Had stale references to dead `.claude/get-shit-done/` paths (old GSD directory layout); fixed to point at current `.claude/gsd-core/` structure.

workflow: GSD profile-user workflow's CLAUDE.md artifact lands at the repo root by default, not inside `.claude/CLAUDE.md` where project instructions live — verify placement before accepting.
lint-staged auto-applied fixes on the first commit in the chore branch, so the commit had two rounds (lint-staged output, then config commit).
GSD config changes on `main` need to be moved to a feature branch before committing per repo conventions.
When verifying stale docs, fan-out verification against the live repo (checking actual MCP config files, release manifests, husky hooks) catches wrong assumptions that reading docs alone would miss.

friction: Root CLAUDE.md placement was unexpected — the profile-user workflow created it at repo root instead of `.claude/CLAUDE.md`, requiring manual awareness and a subsequent merge step.
`.claude/claude.md` used lowercase filename which required careful casing checks before deletion.
Working tree was on `main` with uncommitted changes from the GSD config step, which couldn't be committed directly due to the branch policy.
open_items: Global `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` still contains the older, lower-confidence profile table — user opted not to update it during profiling; the new evidence-backed profile only loads via `/gsd-dev-preferences`.
The broken `.husky/commit-msg` commitlint hook (clobbered in commit 0d37d710b) was documented but not fixed — only PR-title CI enforces conventional commits locally.
